Nothing was loaded or executed in AutoCAD (no acad process started); builds only compile against the installed managed assemblies. Design: core-rs (pure, no AutoCAD: designation ct21d.designation.rs.v1, PathRegions, ScratchRootGuard/ScratchVerifier/SideDbLedger, TOL_SCALE analyzer/classifier/record/offline verifier, census and write-back logic, runners over thin host interfaces); rs (AutoCAD DLL: SideDbWriter is the ONLY type that calls write APIs and only on a Database it created with new Database(true,true)/(false,true), noDocument always true; ScratchSaver is the ONLY SaveAs, of a SideDbHandle to a guard-authorized flat CT21D_*.dwg under the scratch root, create-new, SHA-256 recorded; SideDbReader read-only ForRead; SideDbHandle; adapters; 3 plain non-Session commands, once per session); tools-rs (offline, writes nothing: scan-rs, imports-list-rs, privileged-list-rs, scratch-verify, tolscale-verify, ledger-verify, hash). Result files go through the existing R0 EvidenceWriter (create-new). RS prohibited-API analysis reuses the R0 scan engine UNCHANGED (referenced as a library) with: allowed-apis-rs.txt (810 entries; write members scoped only to SideDbWriter and ScratchSaver), rs-waivers.txt (10 scoped waivers whose maximum is fixed in the scan source, RsWaivers.Waivable), privileged-surface/callers/expected-commands lists, plus an RS IL layer (R-RS-DB-CTOR constants+noDocument, R-RS-SAVE-SCOPE incl. path-from-ScratchTarget.FullPath and straight-line AssertCreatable, R-RS-READDWG-SCOPE, surface-Autodesk-free, surface pin, caller pin). 164 negative-control fixtures x 3 checks all fail as required (WorkingDatabase/MdiActiveDocument.Database in a write, SaveAs outside ScratchSaver / unvalidated path / no guard / wrong overload, Database ctor outside the factory, DocumentManager.Open/Add, Wblock/Insert/DeepClone, File.Copy over the library, Process.Start, etc.), plus positive, spoof, list-mutation and real-DLL mutation controls. Results: RS suite 1318 passed (339 [Fact]/[Theory] methods) in Release and Debug; R0 suite 509 passed in Release and Debug; RS scan CLEAN on core-rs/tools-rs/rs and lists CLEAN; R0 scan CLEAN (R0 list hashes unchanged); freeze-v35 Holds=true; git diff main HEAD -- src empty; git status: only untracked new files (the single tracked modification, docs/automation/decisions/I-52.md section 242, pre-existed my work). No git add/commit/push. The final authority remains independent human source review plus the recorded hashes (README lists residual limits).

Round 1 fixed. The one major (MAJOR-1) is resolved. Of the cheap minors I fixed the drive-root, private-copy reparse, undeclared-scratch and flag-release findings. Both RS test configurations pass 1324/1324 (1318 old + 6 new). R0 509/509 pass, both scans are CLEAN, and ledger-verify reports no difference. Nothing was run on AutoCAD, and no file changed under src/, tests/, the R0 folder or other eng/ folders. The privileged callers list is unchanged, and the lists changed only as listed below.

MAJOR-1: the offline V6 equivalence (D_A==0 iff K_pres==52) in core-rs/TolScaleRecord.cs now uses D_A over the PF-1 in-scope rows only, as design 2.3 says "for these rows". The reviewer's attack (a host that loses only nextDown(1.0), so all 132 PF-1 rows are exact and D_A is 2^-53 over all 135 rows) is now a test, and Verify returns empty for it. The reviewer's other V6 case was a tampered Kpres. Under the new calculation the check reports it as SUMMARY_MISMATCH:Kpres only, and the existing tampered-Kpres test covers that. The R0 flag EquivalenceDaZeroIffKpres52 has the same all-rows flaw, but I did not touch R0, and RS runtime code no longer reads it. Only the older RS tests still assert it.

Minors fixed:
- **Drive root:** PathRegions.IsDriveRoot is new. TextProblem returns DRIVE_ROOT and the ScratchRootGuard constructor refuses a drive root.
- **Private copy identity:**
  - The preflight, AuthorizePrivateCopy and AssertReadable now refuse a reparse point (symbolic link), including the OP2 read-back source.
  - A hard link of the library cannot be detected without P/Invoke. This is documented in the README.
- **Undeclared state after a late failure:**
  - If post-processing throws after the side effects, each of the three runners now writes a minimal rs-run-*.json (INVALID, POST_PROCESSING_FAILED:<type>, the scratch ledger) through the create-new writer.
  - The record is built by the new pure RsFailSafe.TryBuild, so no IO was added to a non-approved caller.
  - If the record already exists, the write is refused and the original exception still propagates. Reproduced as a test.
- **Designation errors and the once-per-session flag:** a missing or invalid designation file now releases the flag and reports a refusal. Executed on a host only, so this one has no test.

Other changes:
- allowed-apis-rs.txt gained 4 entries: File.GetAttributes scoped to RsPreflight, Path.GetPathRoot scoped to PathRegions, the RsRefusedException constructor scoped to RsGateCommands, and the EvidenceWriterException type.
- The README has new residual limits and a new deviation 11.
- New test file tests/ReviewRound1Tests.cs.

Not changed (see open questions): MIN-1, MIN-2 and the governedDocumentPath comparison, MIN-4 to MIN-9, and the scan holes M-1 to M-4. Of the test gaps in M-5, the numeric bound of 8 files and the Combine escape check remain unasserted.

The README says the scan holes (delegate laundering, uncounted sites, arbitrary reads) are caught by source review and hashes only. No scan rule was added, because that would change scan code and invalidate approval beyond the requested fixes.

minors: MIN-A (core-rs/PathRegions.cs TextProblem/IsDriveRoot, ScratchRootGuard ctor): the round-1 DRIVE_ROOT refusal is incomplete for UNC. Reproduced: TextProblem(@"\\server\share\") returns "" (accepted) while @"\\server\share" returns DRIVE_ROOT; @"\\localhost\C$\a" is accepted. Path.GetPathRoot has no trailing separator for UNC, so the string comparison full==root fails. A share root with a trailing backslash passes as evidence root or scratch root. Impact is low, because the scratch root must be empty at start and the aliases are undetectable anyway. Fix: compare Norm(full) to Norm(root), or document it.

MIN-B (core-rs/TolScaleRunner.cs:92-99, WriteBackRunner.cs:234-240, DynCensus.cs:240-247): the round-1 fail-safe record covers only the second try block. The S8 checks run outside any try: Sha256Hex.OfFile(PrivateCopyPath/LibraryPath) and ScratchVerifier.Verify. If one throws after the OP2 DWG was saved (for example the private copy is locked or removed mid-run, or Verify gets an IOException), no rs-run-*.json is written. The scratch DWG then stays undeclared, the command line reports NOT_RECORDED, and the in-session flag stays set. The next preflight fails closed with SCRATCH_ROOT_HAS_UNDECLARED_ENTRY_AT_START. So it is detectable, but the implementer's claim of no undeclared state after a late failure is only partly true. Fix: move the try boundary up to just after the host section, or build the fail-safe from a minimal verification.

MIN-C (rs/ScratchSaver.cs:24 and ScratchRootGuard.AssertCreatable): create-new for the OP2 DWG is a check-then-use race. AssertCreatable and Database.SaveAs are not atomic, and SaveAs overwrites silently. The window is only exploitable by another process creating CT21D_TOLSCALE_OP2.dwg or CT21D_DIMWRITEBACK_*.dwg in that window. This needs explicit Coordinator acceptance against 'without overwrite' in section 242(a). It is documented in the README but not accepted by any ruling.

MIN-D (RsDesignation / RsGateCommands.cs): the 'one fixed allowlisted root' is not fixed in code or pinned. run-designation-rs.json is read with File.ReadAllText, is not hashed, and its hash is not in the run record. governedDocumentPath is optional and is never compared with DWGPREFIX+DWGNAME, which SysSnapshot records but does not check. Evidence and scratch roots can be any existing directory outside src, library, private copy and product paths. Fail-closed mitigations exist (scratch must be empty, create-new only, no overwrite). It is still an open ruling (MIN-2 and MIN-9 of round 1) and must be accepted explicitly, since the code does not enforce an allowlist.

MIN-E (accepted residuals, verified): hard links, 8.3 aliases, subst and UNC admin-share aliases are not detected. On this machine dir /x showed LONGDI~1 for a long directory name, and Path.GetFullPath does not expand it. A hard link used as the private copy was accepted (tested), as documented. A symlink and a junction were refused where the process could create them; mklink for a symlink failed for lack of privilege, so the symlink branch was not run and is covered only by test reading. These are safe for writes: the private copy and the library are only read, and SaveAs targets must not exist, so an alias of an existing file is refused by ExistsAnyCase. Because a short name contains '~', it cannot match the name pattern CT21D_[A-Za-z0-9]...

MIN-F (host unknowns, all marked HOST-TO-CONFIRM, none a write to the governed document): entity construction in a side database may consult HostApplicationServices.WorkingDatabase for default layer or style. RecomputeDimensionBlock and the dynamic property collection may behave differently without a document. SaveAs may leave companion or temp files, which ScratchVerifier would report as undeclared and make the run INVALID. These can only produce INVALID or UNKNOWN evidence.

MIN-G (scan holes M-1 to M-4 from round 1 remain, documented, not closed): delegate/ldftn laundering of a listed privileged call; uncounted Database, SaveAs and ReadDwgFile sites; arbitrary-path File.ReadAllText in RsGateCommands (read only). Source review confirmed none is exploited today: grep found no DllImport, Process.Start, Registry, network, reflection invoke, File.Write, Directory.Create, WorkingDatabase, SetSystemVariable or Document lock or open in core-rs, rs or tools-rs.

MIN-H (minor): TextProblem calls Path.GetFullPath via IsDriveRoot. A NotSupportedException from a malformed designation path would not be caught by the Execute catch list (IOException, FormatException, ArgumentException, JsonException). It would surface as NOT_RECORDED and keep the session flag, instead of REFUSED. The result is still fail-closed.
checks: Source read line by line: core-rs (PathRegions, ScratchRootGuard, RsRunSupport, RsDesignation, ScratchVerifier, TolScaleRunner, WriteBackRunner, DynCensus, TolScaleRecord, TolScaleAnalysis), rs (HostAdapters, RsGateCommands, ScratchSaver, SideDbHandle, SideDbReader, SideDbWriter), tools-rs/Program.cs and the lists. SideDbHandle has an internal constructor, called only from those two methods. No WorkingDatabase, document database, Document lock or open, Insert, XrefAttach or DeepClone to a governed database. MAJOR-1 fix reviewed: TolScaleOfflineVerifier now computes D_A over the PF-1 in-scope rows only (daPf1). Non-finite rows are unobserved and skipped. PF-1 rows contain no zeros, so bit-identity and numeric equality coincide there. The equivalence with K_pres is therefore sound for PF-1. minors: MIN-A (Owner Q-O-1 'raiz fijada por tuple/package' / MIN-2): the roots, the private copy path and hash, and the governed-document path come from run-designation-rs.json, which is not hashed in-process (only the DLLs are self-pinned) and whose hash is not in the run record. Nothing in the code is wrong, but the fixity of the allowlisted root rests on the CAD manager putting this file in the package v3 hash set. Recommend the Coordinator rule that it is a hashed package member and that the CAD manager compares governedDocumentPath with DWGPREFIX+DWGNAME. The instrument only compares DWGNAME/DWGPREFIX before and after.

MIN-B (partial fail-safe, RsRunSupport/TolScaleRunner.cs:~75-95, WriteBackRunner.cs:~496-510, DynCensus.cs:~110-125): the round-1 'POST_PROCESSING_FAILED' record only covers the second try block. An exception thrown between the first catch and the second try (Sha256Hex.OfFile of the private copy or library, ScratchVerifier.Verify) propagates with no rs-run record, so an already saved OP2 DWG stays undeclared. Failure is fail-closed (the next preflight refuses on SCRATCH_ROOT_HAS_UNDECLARED_ENTRY_AT_START), but the README claim that late failures always declare the ledger is slightly too strong. Reproduction: make the library file unreadable after the SaveAs (needs a host-side race). Not exploitable without a fault.

MIN-C (single execution, MIN-1): no 'started' marker is persisted before the first side effect. A crash before the first record or the OP2 SaveAs (the latter leaves a DWG that blocks the next preflight) lets a new session rerun the same designation. In addition the designation 'attempt' is only >=1 (schemas/ct21d.designation.rs.v1.json:26) and the instrument does not require attempt==1 or a new run id. TS-D-07 and 2.5 INVALID ('a rerun needs the Coordinator's authorization') are enforced only by the manager's procedure. Coordinator ruling needed (a create-new marker would add an output file).

MIN-D (MIN-7 / S1): a declared manual load route (loadRouteScripted=false) or otherAcadProcess=true is a refusal before any side effect, not an INVALID record as design 2.5 states, and the refusal releases the once-per-session flag, so the CAD manager can edit the declaration and retype without a ruling. Declarations are not observations.

MIN-E (design 2.4 'Normal=+Z and Rotation=0 are set and verified'): SideDbWriter.AppendScaledReferences (rs/SideDbWriter.cs:~92-111) relies on constructor defaults and only verifies on read (V3). Behaviour is correct (a non-identity pose makes the row UNKNOWN), but 'set' is not literal.
